thread:
laura: FYI NimbleBank reporting repeated 429s during the 00:00 UTC startup window. They say nothing else changed except a scheduler rollout last week.

jin: Do we have a sample of their job? Could be a top-of-minute stampede.

laura: They attached this snippet:
```
#!/bin/bash
for i in $(seq 1 80); do
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input": "ping"}' &
done
wait
```

rachel: 80 parallel at :00 will absolutely exceed typical RPM smoothing. Looks like docs need an example for cron-heavy clients. :grimacing:

ops-bot: :warning: Observed rejects for org nimblebank (org_789) at 00:00:00-00:04: timestamped 429 rate_limit_exceeded (requests_per_minute). Aggregate peak ~450 req/min seen, sustained 4s bursts.

jin: I replayed in staging with 80 parallel curls, got 429s ~12s in. Reducing to 12 parallel eliminates errors.

laura: Customer says their scheduler spins up 80 workers intentionally. They don't have jitter capability.

rachel: Two paths: short-term quota bump for their org during midnight, or encourage them to proxy through a buffer. We can also enable a per-org smoothing policy if needed.

prod-oncall: I'm ok with a temporary, scheduled RPM bump for the next 3 runs while they deploy a client fix. Need support lead sign-off. Also will monitor.

jin: Logs also show token counts spiked (TPM) but the rejection reason flagged requests_per_minute primarily. So both could be relevant depending on prompt size.

laura: Sent suggested client mitigations: add jitter, stagger worker start times, add linear backoff on 429 (not busy-loop). Shared snippet:
```
# quick jitter example
sleep $((RANDOM % 10))
for i in $(seq 1 80); do
  (curl ... ) &
done
wait
```

rachel: I drafted an SDK helper: CronSafeRunner that spreads N requests over M seconds and retries with jitter. I'll post repo link in KB when ready.

support-bot: :information_source: Ticket NB-554 updated by laura: "Customer tested jitter patch, success rate 92% with minor retries." 2415551305

laura: Can ops flip on 1s-resolution histograms for nimblebank for 00:00-00:06 UTC for next 5 days? We need to verify smoothing effect.

prod-oncall: Done. Enabling extra telemetry. Will alert if >3% of requests are 429 after mitigation.

jin: If they can't change scheduler, we should offer managed buffering: a small proxy that admits traffic at our pace and queues requests for them. It's more invasive but effective.

rachel: Also adding a KB: "Scheduled job alignment -> RPM spikes" with examples, code, and a support contact for temporary quota. Will include recommended rate hints for cron-based workloads.

laura: Ops, can you do a one-off RPM bump for next midnight while they test? We'll restrict to 00:00-00:06 UTC and log it.

prod-oncall: Approved for 3 runs only. I'll apply limits and tag the change.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Quota change applied: org_789 RPM increased from 300 -> 900 for 00:00-00:06 UTC on next 3 days. Audit ID: Q-2026-789

laura: Customer ran test with our jitter patch tonight: result — 98% success, a handful of retries succeeded after backoff. They still want permanent guidance.

jin: We'll follow up with the SDK helper + KB + invite to beta of managed buffer.

rachel: I'll get KB live in ~24 hours. Draft includes: why minute-aligned jobs cause issues, client fixes, server-side options, and how to request a temporary bump.

support-bot: :information_source: Ticket NB-554 updated: "KB link added, temporary quota scheduled, monitoring enabled." 2415551440

laura: Closing internal thread once we confirm 3 successful midnight runs with <1% 429s. Thanks team. :pray:
